Claim 1 (Currently amended): A method of analyzing one or more plant embryos comprising: (a) collecting shed cellular material from one or more embryos by agitating the one or more embryos in a non-destructive medium that is not harmful to the viability of the embryos; (b) obtaining DNA from the shed cellular material; (c) performing a molecular analysis of the DNA obtained in step (b); and (d) germinating at least one of said one or more embryos.

Claim 2 (Currently amended): The method of claim 1 wherein the non-destructive medium consists essentially of water or a solution that does not harm the viability of the embryos.

Claim 7 (Currently amended): The method of claim 1 wherein DNA is obtained by incubating the shed cellular material with a cell wall degrading enzyme that does not harm the viability of the embryos.

Claim 11 (Currently amended): The method of claim 1 wherein the one or more embryos comprise one or more immature embryos that are viable.

Claim 13 (Currently amended): The method of claim 1, wherein said molecular analysis is genotyping performed on DNA that has been obtained from the shed cellular material.

Claim 17 (Currently amended): The method of claim 13 further comprising selecting one or more embryos based on genotype, wherein the selection is performed in a manner that does not harm the viability of the embryos.

Claim 19 (Currently amended): The method of claim 18 wherein any of the steps resulting in selection of one or more embryos is automated and performed in a manner that does not harm the viability of the embryos.
